_: Sprites knowingly installed outside the value bands, with the reason.
STRUCTURAL failures are never excepted — wrong dimensions, a file that will
not decode, an empty cell, a baked matte. Those are always errors. Only the
value bands (contrast, spread, saturation) and facing separation can be
waived here, because those are review judgements and a band calibrated on
one art direction does not automatically transfer to another.
A stale entry is a failure: tools/sim_test.mjs asserts every id listed here
genuinely fails something, so an exception cannot outlive the problem.
